raw_text: Develop and apply knowledge of author, audience, and context to discern and establish the purpose of texts being interpreted or constructed and to evaluate the extent to which those texts achieve those purposes. (I/C)
competency_statement: Students develop and use knowledge about the author, audience, and context to identify the purpose of texts they read or create and to judge how well those texts meet their purposes.
observable_behaviors: Identify the author, audience, and context of a text.
Determine the purpose of a text based on author, audience, and context.
Evaluate how well a text achieves its intended purpose.
Apply understanding of author, audience, and context when creating texts.
skill_clauses: Develop knowledge of author, audience, and context to discern the purpose of texts being interpreted or constructed.
Apply knowledge of author, audience, and context to establish the purpose of texts.
Evaluate the extent to which texts achieve their purposes based on author, audience, and context.

student_actions.recognition_identification: Recognize author, audience, and context in texts.
student_actions.procedural_application: Apply knowledge of author, audience, and context to determine text purpose and evaluate texts.
student_actions.reasoning_explanation: Explain how author, audience, and context influence the purpose of a text and its effectiveness.
student_actions.comprehension_response: Interpret texts by discerning purpose and evaluate texts based on how well they achieve that purpose.
